Institute Overview

The Institut de Robòtica i Informàtica Industrial (IRI) is a Joint Research Center of CSIC and the Technical University of Catalonia (UPC) in Barcelona, Spain. It is accredited as a María de Maeztu Unit of Excellence by the Spanish Government. Research lines include Automatic Control, Computational Robotics, Mobile Robotics, and Perception & Manipulation.

Research Areas

  • Automatic Control
  • Computational Robotics
  • Mobile Robotics
  • Perception and Manipulation
  • Social Human-Robot Interaction
  • Deformable Object Manipulation
  • Computer Vision and Machine Learning

Funding Routes for PhD and Postdoc

IRI lists permanent funding routes for pre-doctoral and post-doctoral contracts:

TypeProgrammeDuration/Funder
PostdocRamón y Cajal5 years - Spanish Government
PostdocJuan de la Cierva2 years - Spanish Government
PostdocBeatriu de Pinós3 years - Catalan Government
PostdocMarie Skłodowska-Curie Actions1-2 years - European Commission
PhDContratos predoctorales (former FPI)4 years - Spanish Government
PhDFPU4 years - Spanish Government
PhDFI-DGRCatalan Government
TechnicianPTA3 years - Spanish Government
Undergrad/MasterJAE Intro3 months - CSIC

Financial Coverage

  • FPI PhD example: 4-year PhD fully covered with gross salary of €16,422/year (2018 figure) plus funding for conference attendance, journal publication costs, research stays abroad, and lab experiments.
  • JAE Intro internships: €700-800/month for 4-9 months.
  • Stipends vary by funding programme. Confirm exact amounts with supervisor.

Eligibility Criteria

  • PhD: Master's degree in mathematics, computer science, robotics, or related field.
  • Interest in robotics and computer vision.
  • Admission to a PhD programme required.
  • Fluent English.
  • Postdoc: PhD in relevant field.
  • Open to international applicants.

Current Opportunities

  • Master's thesis (TFM) and final-year project (TFG) proposals are open. Contact supervisors directly.
  • Past PhD positions (FPI) in motor skill reinforcement learning and motion planning.
  • Past postdoc positions in manipulation of deformable objects and social human-robot interaction.

Application Process

  1. For Master thesis or TFG projects: email the listed supervisor directly with CV and motivation.
  2. For any position (postdoc, PhD, technician, internships): send CV to jobs@iri.upc.edu referencing the relevant opportunity or funding programme.
  3. For grant-funded routes: check official portals for next call dates and pair application with an IRI supervisor.
  4. IRI coordinates paperwork with the relevant ministry or agency.

Contact

  • General applications: jobs@iri.upc.edu
  • General enquiries: info@iri.upc.edu
  • Address: C/ Llorens i Artigas 4-6, 08028 Barcelona, Spain

Official Link

https://www.iri.upc.edu/join

Important Notes

  • All formal job postings are currently closed. Monitor the Join Us page for new openings.
  • Next FPI PhD calls and EU-project postdocs expected on same page.
  • Strategy: secure the grant yourself or align with a supervisor who has an opening, then email CV.

MSCA 2026 rates: doctoral candidates receive a living allowance of €4,010 per month plus a mobility allowance of €710 per month (€660 family top-up where eligible), adjusted by the national correction coefficient.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: Rolling - CV accepted year-round. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
